summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. priced $21,832,000 of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due September 30, 2032, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program via a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement. The notes are senior unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and EURO STOXX 50 indices, pay a monthly $8.33 contingent coupon per $1,000 note, and autocall monthly from September 2027 if the worst performer meets its Call Value. Issue price is $1,000 per note, issued September 30, 2026. Principal is at risk below the threshold value. This is a routine structured-note takedown, not a special situation.
